verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair privacy-posture question for a SaaS fraud-detection service that processes customer and payment data. The evidence pack has nothing on retention periods, deletion APIs or data-deletion requests for Radar data. The value lists, rules, reviews and risk settings in the pack cover fraud configuration, not retention, so they are adjacent features at most.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
